title: Monitoring & Evaluation and Data Analytics Specialist
description:
**Mahila Abhivruddhi Society (APMAS)**  
**Job Description for the position of M & E and Data Analytics Specialist – SWAYAMSHREE 2.0 (Andhra Pradesh)**

**Implementing Partner: APMAS | State Partner: SERP Andhra Pradesh | Duration: 3 Years**

**Location** Vijayawada / Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh

**Engagement** Full-time (3 Years)

**Reporting To** State Project Lead – SWAYAMSHREE 2.0

**Overall Purpose**  
Support the SWAYAMSHREE 2.0 team in reaching 1.4 million rural women-led enterprises achieving a sustained annual
  
net household income of ₹1,00,000 or more (Lakhpati Didis). Design and operationalise the programme’s Monitoring,
  
Evaluation & Learning (MEL), Digital Systems, Data Analytics, and AI Enablement Framework to track household net
  
income growth, enterprise graduation, market performance, and programme impact in real time.

**Key Responsibilities**  
 **MEL Framework & Net Income Measurement:** Develop programme KPIs, logical frameworks,

baseline/midline/endline methodologies, and standardised measurement tools to rigorously track enterprise
  
profitability and the ₹1,00,000+ annual net household income benchmark.

 **Real-Time Dashboards & AI Integration: Build interactive MIS dashboards for state and district decision-making;**  
deploy predictive analytics and AI-enabled tools for enterprise tracking, risk/drop-off early warning, and performance
  
assessment.

 **Digital Systems Integration:** Integrate SWAYAMSHREE 2.0 monitoring systems with existing SERP AP and NRLM
  
digital platforms to streamline field data capture, avoid duplication, and enable seamless reporting across state,
  
district, and mandal levels.

 **Market Price Tracking & Data Governance: Track commodity price trends and price realisation; enforce strict data**  
validation, quality assurance, privacy, and governance protocols to ensure reliable programme data.

 **Performance Reviews, Learning & Donor Reporting: Facilitate periodic data-driven programme review meetings,**  
analyse implementation gaps and emerging trends, and generate analytical insights for donor reports and strategic
  
course correction.

**Qualifications & Experience**  
**Education: Postgraduate degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Monitoring & Evaluation, Computer Science, Rural**  
Development, or an equivalent discipline.

**Experience:** 8–10+ years in MEL, data analytics, MIS architecture, and digital transformation in large-scale rural
  
development or livelihoods programmes, with a strong track record in donor reporting.

**Key Skills: Data analytics, MIS dashboard creation, predictive modeling, AI tool integration, data governance, and bilingual**  
fluency (Telugu & English).

**APPLY ONLINE • https://forms.gle/mMXMfu548kQHNuhUA**

**Apply by 05 December 2026**  
**For queries: hr@apmas.org**
